lines.en: The abysshound trots with light paws.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴在后面摇个不停
lines.en: Its tail keeps wagging behind it.
It follows its nose along the ground.
It loops half a circle around you.
It runs two strides and looks back.
Its fur carries a blue sheen in the dark.

lines.zh: 它跳过一块石头，很轻巧
lines.en: It clears a stone neatly.

lines.zh: 它贴着你的腿走了一段
lines.en: It walks a stretch pressed against your leg.
It darts ahead, then waits for you.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在地上没留下声
lines.en: Its paws leave no sound.

lines.zh: 它绕回来，蹭了蹭你的手
lines.en: It comes back and nuzzles your hand.
It walks ahead of you, leading.

lines.zh: 它的耳朵一直朝前竖着
lines.en: Its ears stay pricked forward.
The abysshound sits and watches you.
It rests its head on its forepaws.
An ear swivels.
It licks a paw.

lines.zh: 它身上有一层淡淡的雾光
lines.en: A faint misty glow clings to it.
It yawns, showing teeth.
It curls up a little.
It lifts its head, ears up.
Then relaxes again.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴尖在轻拍地面
lines.en: Its tail tip taps the ground.

lines.zh: 它把鼻子埋进自己的尾巴
lines.en: It buries its nose in its own tail.
Its breathing is even.
It lies on its side, eyes open.
Its ears flick now and then.
It looks ready to rise at any moment.

lines.zh: 渊犬抬头看你，眼睛圆圆的
lines.en: The abysshound looks up, round-eyed.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，耳朵朝你那边歪。
lines.en: I lift my head and tip my ears toward you.
Its tail begins to swing.
It edges a little closer.
It wants to lick your hand and holds back.
Its ears lean toward you.
It sits and looks up, waiting.
It gives a soft whine.
It puts a paw on your shoe.
It circles you sniffing.

lines.zh: 它确认是你，尾巴摇得更快
lines.en: Sure it is you, its tail wags faster.
It rests its head against your leg.
It backs half a step and comes in again.

lines.zh: 它的目光一直没离开你的脸
lines.en: Its gaze never leaves your face.
It seems a little nervous.
It touches your palm with its nose.
It whines once, very short.

lines.zh: 它把尾巴夹了一下，又摇起来
lines.en: Its tail tucks, then wags again.
It settles beside you, quiet.

lines.zh: 它抬头，像在等你的指令
lines.en: It looks up as if waiting for a command.
The abysshound whines and backs off.
Its tail tucks and ears flatten.
It trembles and looks at you.
It hides behind you.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在地上抓了一下
lines.en: A paw scrapes the ground.
It whimpers low.
It slowly comes back.
It presses against your leg.
It licks the wound.
It looks up, still trusting.

lines.zh: 渊犬盯着你手里的食物
lines.en: The abysshound fixes on the food.
It steps in and back.
It sits, tail sweeping the ground.
It gives a small whine.
It sniffs at your hand.
It takes a piece carefully.
Done, it sits again and waits.

lines.zh: 它的头一直跟着你的手
lines.en: Its head tracks your hand.
It licks its lips.
It puts a forepaw on your knee.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴摇得停不下来
lines.en: Its tail will not stop wagging.
It tries for a second piece.

lines.zh: 它咬着东西跑到一边吃
lines.en: It carries the food aside to eat.
Finished, it runs back.

lines.zh: 我闻到肉味，围着你绕了两圈。
lines.en: I smell meat and circle your feet twice.
It nudges your hand.

lines.zh: 它看着你的口袋，很期待
lines.en: It eyes your pocket hopefully.
The abysshound rolls at the bump.
It gets up and shakes itself.
It comes back and presses against you.
Its paws land on your foot.
It backs off, still excited.
It circles you twice.

lines.zh: 我被撞开，又跑回来贴住你。
lines.en: Knocked aside, I run back and press against you.

lines.zh: 它用头顶了下你的膝盖
lines.en: It butts its head against your knee.
It takes it as a game.
It looks ready to do it again.
Two abysshounds sit side by side.
They touch noses and sniff.
It licks behind its partner's ear.
They lean together.
Their tails wag together.
They trot around each other.

lines.zh: 一只趴下，另一只靠着它
lines.en: One lies down; the other leans on it.
Their breathing syncs.

lines.zh: 它们的雾光交叠在一起
lines.en: Their misty glow overlaps.
They fall asleep like that.
The abysshound snaps up the food.

lines.zh: 它把东西带到一边去吃
lines.en: It carries it off to eat.
A paw pins it and it gnaws.

lines.zh: 它对不合口的东西闻了闻就走
lines.en: It sniffs what it dislikes and walks off.
It brings the item back to you.

lines.zh: 它把战利品藏在自己的窝边
lines.en: It hides the prize by its own nest.

lines.zh: 它摇着尾巴把东西放好
lines.en: Tail wagging, it sets it down.
It returns for the next one.
It licks your fingers.
It huffs, satisfied.
The abysshound stands up straight.
Its ears rake fully forward.
It puts itself in front of you.

lines.zh: 它喉间压出警告的低音
lines.en: A low warning presses from its throat.
Its fur stands up.

lines.zh: 它开始朝那个方向低吼
lines.en: It growls toward something.

lines.zh: 它退到你腿边，仍朝前看
lines.en: It backs to your leg, still facing out.
Its tail goes rigid.
Its forepaws dig in.
It is ready to charge out.

lines.zh: 渊犬在你身前慢慢移动
lines.en: The abysshound paces in front of you.
Its growl does not stop.
It presses half a step forward.

lines.zh: 它回头看你一眼，又转回去
lines.en: It glances back at you, then forward.
It squares across your front.
Its fur stays bristled.
It circles toward the threat.
It does not bark, only growls.
Its weight sits very low.
It waits for a signal from you.
The abysshound leaps and bites.
It bites down and shakes its head hard.
Its claws rake armour.
It slams in and drives the foe back.
It returns and stands before you.
It barks and charges again.
It holds on, hind legs braced.
Thrown off, it rolls half over.
It is up and lunging at once.
It takes the blow meant for you.
Pawsteps come out of the mist.
The abysshound runs out of the dark.
It stops a few paces in front of you.
It shakes the mist off.

lines.zh: 它抬头看你，尾巴开始摇
lines.en: It looks up, tail starting to wag.
It comes and sniffs your hand.

lines.zh: 然后它贴在你腿边站好
lines.en: Then it settles against your leg.
Its misty glow slowly dims.
Its ears relax.

lines.zh: 它像是找到了要跟的人
lines.en: It looks like it has found who to follow.
Singed fur sends it leaping away.
It rolls twice on landing.

lines.zh: 在水里它拼命刨，喘得急
lines.en: In water it paddles hard, panting.
The blast throws it aside.
An arrow grazes its flank.
Odd force passes through and it shudders all over.
Hunger shows its ribs.
Lightning locks it for a moment.
The void pulls; its paws claw the ground.
